I get it, Chris. You ordered your first 40T on July 31 and you're still waiting for it. I'm sorry it has taken this long.

Our September 27 email about the delay included a $50 code for your next purchase. If you use it with your credit, the $799 unit comes to $749, and your $777.23 covers all of that. The only thing left would be shipping and any sales tax.

You're welcome, Chris. The team will get back to you by email about covering the rest.

Before you go, one quick question: you're still waiting on your first 40T, so what makes you want a second one now rather than waiting to see the first one run?

I have watched it from the initial discovery and think its a good purchase.  I might be wrong, but seems like you had a quality issue with  the MM and you have figured it out.  I couldn't get the hashrate with bundling other miners, so figured I would just purchase another.  Other reason is I will forget about the credit if I don't use it. lol

That makes sense, and thanks for telling me. You read it right. Production was stopped over a control board issue, that's now fixed and the final version is approved. One 40T in Turbo does about 42 TH/s, which is hard to match by stacking smaller units.

Your credit stays on your account until you use it, so it won't disappear. The team will email you about the rest.

One last thing if you don't mind: which miners did you try bundling before you went for the 40T?
I just looked at the different options and the price went above the 799 to achieve the 40T hashrate.  If you have any ideas I'm open to options.
Ran the power-cost calculator
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30

You did the math right, Chris. Nothing we sell gets you 42 TH/s for less than one Magic M. 40T at $799. That works out to about $19 per TH, the lowest in the store.

The closest option is the Harlo B30 at $899. It does 30 TH/s at about 485 W, so you'd pay more and get less hashrate.

The only cheaper route is the 3-unit 40T pack at $2,247, about $749 a unit. That's only worth it if you want three. The 2-unit pack is sold out.

For one more unit, the single 40T is still the one I'd pick.
OK sounds good - Lets stay with the 1 MM

Good choice, Chris. Here's the checkout link for one Magic M. 40T: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48890366853375:1

Sign in with (email hidden) so your $777.23 credit shows up, and enter the $50 code from our September 27 email. This unit is Batch 10, which ships December 21, 2026.

The team is still looking at your request to cover what's left. If you'd rather hear back from them before you check out, that works too.
I'll wait - let me know

Sounds good, Chris. Your request is already with the team, and they'll email you at (email hidden) with their answer. You don't need to keep this chat open.

Your $777.23 credit stays on your account until you're ready, and the checkout link will still work then.
